limitations: Directed fault injections and small production cohort cannot estimate real 99.9% availability.
Fault/capacity model runs real coordinator/helper but not real network or hosted scheduling; PostgreSQL suite separately uses real transactions/locks.
No physical iPhone/Android captive-browser or external internet test this round.
A2-T03 corroborates A2-C01 and is not a tenth group.
Before-join timeout tests verify bounded completion, not yet the full future recoverable error contract.
Retry-After output property is a proposed representation; equivalent future scheduling/deadline must preserve the same cooldown semantics.
